split_honesty_note: The 20,000-row sample may overlap training data and must not be called a held-out test split. The original training notebook (proj.ipynb) trained on the Sentiment140 corpus without preserving a fixed test index set.

neutral_handling.note: Sentiment140 contains only binary positive and negative labels. Neutral is an unlearned heuristic overlay applied when TextBlob polarity lands between -0.10 and +0.10 and is excluded from binary metrics.

known_limitations.title: Neutrality is a heuristic, not an ML classification
known_limitations.detail: Sentiment140 contains only binary positive and negative tweets. Neutral outputs are triggered when TextBlob polarity falls within [-0.10, +0.10]. Users can adjust or disable this band.

known_limitations.title: Inability to parse sarcasm and inverted irony
known_limitations.detail: Sarcastic comments like 'Oh great, another outage right at checkout!' have strongly positive lexical weights ('great') which misclassify negative intent.

known_limitations.title: 2009 Training Data Distribution Shift
known_limitations.detail: Trained on 2009 Twitter data, modern internet slang ('cooked', 'mid', 'goat', 'rizz') and newer emojis are out-of-vocabulary with zero weight.
